evals.prompt: Create a code-scans skill for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Run in a clone of anomalyco/opencode at its 2026-08-20 commit.
expectations: SKILL.md exists at .agents/skills/code-scans-<project>/ with frontmatter name equal to code-scans-<project> and a description that names the repo
.claude/skills/code-scans-<project> is a symlink that resolves to the .agents/skills directory
Every repo path named in backticks in the generated SKILL.md exists in git ls-files (check-skill-paths.sh reports zero MISSING)
The generated SKILL.md contains no machine-specific absolute path (/Users/, /private/tmp, /home/)
The generated skill does not set disable-model-invocation, so the survey can trigger on its own
The generated skill has a protected/intentional-by-default section whose entries each cite a repo source (doc, note, contract file, or manifest) rather than asserting intent without evidence
The generated skill names this repo's own check/lint/dead-code gate commands as found in AGENTS.md or package scripts, with at least one caveat about what the gate cannot see
The generated skill classifies production, non-production, and ambiguous corpora using concrete roots from this repo's tree
The generated skill states where findings go (notes/ADR system or report to maintainer) with a rationale derived from this repo, and whether a survey may implement removals
The run report shows a bounded trial survey: at least two candidates proven or rejected with concrete evidence (file paths and the searches run)
No product code, tests, or docs were modified: changes.diff touches only paths under .agents/ and .claude/
